record.headline: Runpod raised Serverless hourly rates on most GPUs, from about 9% to 25%, and dropped its claim of saving 25% over other Serverless providers.
record.who: Anyone running inference on Runpod Serverless workers; the page does not say whether existing endpoints are repriced.
record.read: Second round of GPU rate rises in a month after the Pods and cluster increases, which points to a general repricing. Removing the savings comparison and the reservation discount wording suggests Runpod is no longer pitching Serverless on price.
record.caveat: The page lists the unit price only; whether existing customers see the new rates is not stated. The 5090 rose $1.58 → $1.79 and the 24 GB tier $0.69 → $0.75.
